"""Matched strict native read ABBA; every timed response is byte exact."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time

N = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H = Path('/tmp/tofudb-integer-native-maps-20261004')
records = []
for index, role in enumerate(['baseline', 'candidate'], 1):
    artifact = N / (role + '-build')
    receipt = json.loads((artifact / 'receipt.json').read_text())
    for name, digest in receipt['sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((artifact / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
    parent = N / f'native-{index}-{role}'
    parent.mkdir()
    data = parent / 'authority'
    data.mkdir()
